Subject: Discovery recap — SOC 2, audit logs, retention & pen-test next steps (Auric Finance)

Hi Emma / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side so we have aligned expectations and clear next steps. High-level pain points you called out: 
- Audit log retention requirements for payment events (target: 12 months) and stricter access controls on those logs.
- Need for clear mapping between Redwood controls and Auric’s SOC 2 control framework (especially around encryption-in-transit and key management).
- Evidence for past pen tests / ability to support customer-led pen testing, plus a preferred timeline for a test window.
- DPA redlines: a few clauses to confirm (data residency, retention, and breach notification SLA).

Goals we discussed:
1) Provide a technical bundle that maps Redwood controls to Auric’s SOC 2 expectations.
2) Confirm retention configuration for payment vs non-payment event types and agree on policy in the DPA.
3) Schedule a compliance deep-dive with your security team to resolve outstanding technical questions and pen-test scope.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Jordan: book a 60-minute compliance deep-dive with Auric security (proposed Aug 4, 09:00 PT).
- Irene: share control matrix + sample audit-log schema + pen-test guidelines (by Jul 29).
- Auric: confirm whether you prefer Redwood-hosted or customer-run pen test and provide any vendor preferences (by Aug 6).
- Jordan: circulate DPA with suggested minimal redlines for your legal review (by Jul 30).

I’ll attach the initial artifacts in a follow-up from Irene, but wanted this recap in your inbox so everyone has the same list of owners.

Attachments (to follow): SOC2_Control_Matrix.xlsx (control mapping), Audit_Log_Schema.json (example), PenTest_Guidelines.pdf (scope/template).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Discovery recap — SOC 2, audit logs, retention & pen-test next steps (Auric Finance)

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A couple of quick clarifications from our side:
1) Retention: Our security policy requires 12 months for payment transaction logs but we typically allow 90 days for non-payment telemetry. Can Redwood support per-event retention windows?
2) Audit log format: can you provide a sample schema (JSON preferred) so our engineers can validate ingestion?
3) SOC 2 artifacts: we will need the latest Type II report under NDA and a mapping to your control owners; is that something you can share or do we need a separate request form?
4) Pen test: we prefer to run customer-led tests with our vetted vendors and would like to see Redwood’s pen-test acceptance criteria and rules of engagement. Our ideal window is mid-September but we can be flexible if Redwood has restrictions.

Please also include any DPA redline guidance — specifically around retention and breach notification timelines.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Security — Auric Finance

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap — SOC 2, audit logs, retention & pen-test next steps (Auric Finance)

Hi Emma / team —

Thanks — answering your questions and attaching the artifacts Jordan noted.

Short answers:
- Per-event retention: yes, Redwood supports configurable retention per event type. We can set payment transaction logs to 12 months and non-payment telemetry to 90 days; retention is configurable via the Console or API.
- Audit log schema: attached Audit_Log_Schema.json (sample shows fields we record for tokenized requests, user ids, request path, timestamps, redaction markers).
- SOC 2: we can share the most recent Type II report under NDA. In the meantime, attached is SOC2_Control_Matrix.xlsx which maps each control family to Redwood owners and artifacts.
- Pen test: attached PenTest_Guidelines.pdf — Redwood accepts customer-led tests. Requirements: 1) test plan submitted 4 weeks prior; 2) agreed out-of-scope components; 3) a short readout call within 5 business days of completion. If Auric wants Redwood to coordinate with a vendor, we can propose two partners.

Action items and dates:
- Irene: send the three artifacts (SOC2_Control_Matrix.xlsx, Audit_Log_Schema.json, PenTest_Guidelines.pdf) — SENT (today).
- Jordan: send initial DPA redline suggestions by Jul 30.
- Auric: confirm preferred pen-test vendor or customer-run scope by Aug 6.

Notes about hosting/data residency: for Auric’s preference we can provision in us-east-1; we’ll include region in the DPA. Also note that audit logs can be exported to your S3 under a controlled delivery if you want direct ingest.

If helpful, I can join the Aug 4 deep-dive to walk the control mapping and answer technical questions.

Best —
Irene Choi
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SOC2_Control_Matrix.xlsx (Excel), Audit_Log_Schema.json (JSON), PenTest_Guidelines.pdf (PDF)]
